As one of the four houses of The Tschuggen Collection AG, our hotel offers 60 individually designed suites and rooms, plus stylish restaurants – including the gourmet highlight Da Vittorio with 18 points of Gault Millau & 2 Michelin stars and the Grand Restaurant, a tribute to nature and the culinary delights of the Engadine – and an impressive 1,200 m2 spa.
